subject.statement: Nikola Tesla, the inventor, founded Tesla, Inc.

summary: The claim that Nikola Tesla founded Tesla, Inc. is false. Nikola Tesla died on 7 January 1943, while Tesla, Inc. was incorporated on 1 July 2003 by Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning, making any direct involvement impossible. The company was named in honor of the inventor, but he had no role in its establishment.

findings.statement: Tesla, Inc. was incorporated on July 1, 2003.
The founders of Tesla, Inc. were Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning.
Nikola Tesla had no involvement in the founding of Tesla, Inc. because he died in 1943, 60 years before the company's incorporation.
